execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cr.compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3833082'
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id,
  cr.compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
```
